rationale: Fixed layout target hash matches original unchanged N13 learner JSON. First learner/source observations are retained verbatim. N13/N14 proposed leaf and domain bytes match P001; the consumer selector change is isolated to the scoped Page rule.

Actual TextbookFormula emits data-testid="textbook-formula-"+block.id on its reading-formula-line, containing reading-formula-expression, beneath the Page derivation wrapper carrying data-derivation-id. Thus the new ancestor selector matches the actual consumer structure and is not merely a hypothetical unattached class.

New selector .w048-reading-flow .reading-derivation-chain[data-derivation-id] [data-testid^="textbook-formula-"] .reading-formula-expression has specificity (0,5,0), exceeding base (0,1,0) and legacy narrow row (0,4,0). Both flex and grid alignment properties are present. The prior normal-flex and Q05 narrow-grid failures are statically resolved.

B independently parsed actual global.css/mobile.css/scoped style via cssselect2/tinycss2 on modeled actual consumer ancestry. All 13 N13 derived formula rows passed at 320/350/351/390/430/1440px (78 conditions), including both Q05 rows at the <=350px threshold. Root CSS_CASCADE_CHECK supplies 32 additional modeled scenarios across N13/N14; its pageSHA256 matches the reviewed Page.

Previously checked projection, source figure gates, nine end-row equation-number prop mapping, old record/archive preservation, six new unanswered IDs and first-unresolved Q04-positive resume ordering remain unchanged. Scoped style only activates at exact N13 r5/N14 r11 via contract guard.

PASS is limited to static R04 design, not actual rendering, browser persistence or learner acceptance. The browser produced zero actual DOM checks. R07 retains computed font, true left-edge coordinates, equation-number collisions, wrapping, all save revisions and other-unit regressions.
